precise_statement.evidence: Candidate states Z_S(v)=0 for locally obstructed subsets and otherwise centers 1_{all h in S are prime-like} by train allowed-rate p_S, scoring RMS holdout residual means for |S|=1,2,3.

finite_field_anchor.evidence: F_q[t] side is exact: local obstruction is divisibility of f+a by all irreducible moduli of degree <=2, with separate train/holdout degrees and q=2,3,5 checks.

integer_holdout.evidence: Integer side uses train/holdout splits at N=1000000, 2000000 with endpoint holdout 70431 vertices.

controls.evidence: Z endpoint order2/order3 exceed local random and composite controls, but F_q[t] does not show a matched excess: F_2 order2 above monic=false reducible=false, order3 above monic=false reducible=false; F_3 order2 above monic=false reducible=false, order3 above monic=false reducible=false; F_5 order2 above monic=false reducible=false, order3 above monic=false reducible=false; max low-edge fraction=0.150000.

compression.evidence: The statistic has fixed order-1/2/3 subset tensors, deterministic obstruction subtraction, and a single Beta(1/2,1/2) allowed-rate prior.
